title: NABS Retros feedback template (template.json)
description: A feedback template (retro format). Put it in <templates folder>/<id>/template.json, optionally with a retro.md next to it for the layout of retros created with it.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file (optional; VS Code applies it anyway).

id.patternErrorMessage: Use letters, digits, '-' or '_' (max 40), e.g. team-health.
id.description: Optional: defaults to the folder name, and must match it if given. Saved in each retro's front matter, so don't change it once used.

label.description: Shown in the New Retro form and the Retros view.

description.description: A short explanation shown in the New Retro form.

id.patternErrorMessage: Use letters, digits, '-' or '_' (max 40), e.g. went-well.
id.description: Stored in the feedback file. Don't change it once used.

label.description: Shown in the form and the Retros view.

description.description: A short explanation shown in the form.

icon.description: An emoji shown next to the label.

enumDescriptions: Not placed in a section by the plain summary
section.description: Which retro section this type feeds.

prompt.description: Text the feedback box starts with when this type is chosen, e.g. an outline to fill in ("Why 1: … Why 5:").

value.description: Stored in the feedback file, e.g. green.

label.description: Shown in the form, e.g. Green: healthy.

section.description: Overrides the type's section for entries with this rating.

value.description: Stored in the feedback file, e.g. worse.

label.description: Shown in the form, e.g. Getting worse.

trendScale.description: Optional second scale (e.g. improving / same / getting worse). Entries may pick one.

aiGuidance.description: Extra instructions for Copilot when summarising feedback of this template.
